<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Register a behavioral zone inside a site's area"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sites/{siteCode}/zones"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds a Zone scoped to the given Site. The zone's identity is `SITE-AREA-ZONE` (e.g. `WH1-STOR-AMB`), which is exactly the first three segments of every LocationCode inside it. A Zone cannot be registered against an unknown or non-Active Site. The TemperatureClass and Hazmat flag set here are what PlacementRules match on later, so they are behavioral, not descriptive. Publishes ZoneRegistered.

Clients MUST always send it: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`. A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response verbatim plus the response header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. The key is global (not per route).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}}]}
